name: Laporan Weighbridge (Web)

actor_permissions.conditions: Operator tidak punya akses ke layar web

endpoints.description: Daftar mill untuk pemilih Mill pada Laporan Weighbridge — khusus Admin

error_codes.condition: Pemanggil bukan Admin — ditegakkan di service, bukan di middleware, karena peran terikat mill tidak punya pemilih dan memberinya daftar seluruh mill justru kebocoran yang hendak dihindari

endpoints.description: Daftar Periode Pelaporan yang mencakup jenis stasiun Weighbridge pada mill yang dilihat

query_params.name: business_unit_id
query_params.description: DIABAIKAN untuk peran terikat mill; hanya berlaku bagi Admin

error_codes.condition: Peran tidak diizinkan mengakses laporan ini (mis. Operator)
Akun terikat mill tetapi mill-nya kosong — data akun belum lengkap, bukan akses ditolak; ATAU Admin belum memilih mill

endpoints.description: Seluruh angka laporan untuk satu periode pada satu Production Line, DIPISAH per jenis arus. Tidak menghasilkan satu pun angka gabungan kedua arus, dan tidak memuat angka lama kendaraan di pabrik — tiap trip hanya punya satu penanda waktu

query_params.name: production_line_id
query_params.description: WAJIB. Tanpa ini 422 — bukan diam-diam seluruh line pada mill

query_params.name: business_unit_id
query_params.description: DIABAIKAN untuk peran terikat mill; hanya berlaku bagi Admin

error_codes.condition: Periode milik mill lain dan pemanggil terikat mill, ATAU production_line_id bukan milik mill yang berlaku

endpoints.description: Ekspor seluruh trip sepanjang periode ke CSV, satu baris per trip, kolom konteks diulang tiap baris. Header TIDAK memuat kolom durasi

success_schema.body: StreamedResponse — satu baris per trip; kolom konteks periode, mill, Production Line, dan jenis arus diulang tiap baris; trip tanpa berat bersih tetap jadi baris dengan sel kosong

business_logic: 1. resolveBusinessUnit: peran terikat mill → business_unit_id kiriman klien DIBUANG, dipakai mill akun; Admin → dipakai yang dikirim; akun terikat tanpa mill → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR pada field business_unit_id dengan pesan 'Akun Anda belum terhubung ke mill. Hubungi Admin.', dan daftar seluruh mill TIDAK pernah ditawarkan sebagai jalan keluar. 422 BUKAN 403: pengguna tidak sedang ditolak aksesnya, data akunnya yang belum lengkap — sama seperti kelima laporan stasiun lainnya, yang komentarnya menyebut 'Incomplete input, not refused access — 422, never 403'. Admin yang belum memilih mill juga 422, dengan pesan 'Pilih mill terlebih dahulu untuk menampilkan laporan.'
2. businessUnitOptions: HANYA Admin. Peran lain 403 walau middleware sudah meloloskan permintaannya — penegakan ada di service, karena peran terikat mill tidak punya pemilih mill sama sekali

3. resolveProductionLine: production_line_id wajib milik business_unit yang berlaku; bila milik mill lain → 403; bila tidak dikirim → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR. TIDAK ADA fallback seluruh line — angka tanpa line adalah angka yang tidak dapat ditindaklanjuti

4. listPeriods: hanya periode yang MENDAFTARKAN station_type 'weighbridge' sebagai salah satu stasiunnya — yaitu periode yang punya baris period_stations untuk weighbridge. Status tiap pilihan diambil dari period_stations.status weighbridge (draft/open/closed), BUKAN dari periode itu sendiri: kolom periods.station_type dan periods.status dibuang oleh migrasi 2026_09_26_000040, dan mengakses Period::$status kini MELEMPAR LogicException. Tidak ada lagi 'periode yang tidak menyebut jenis stasiun' — cakupan selalu dinyatakan per jenis stasiun. Status tidak pernah menyaring daftar ini

5. authorizePeriod: 404 bila id tidak ada; 403 bila milik mill lain dan pemanggil terikat mill. Guard peran berjalan SEBELUM lookup, sehingga keberadaan sebuah id tidak bocor ke peran yang tidak diizinkan

6. summary: saring weighbridge_records pada KOLOM production_line_id MILIK RECORD, tidak pernah lewat join ke stations — memindahkan stasiun ke line lain tidak boleh menulis ulang riwayat trip yang sudah terjadi

7. summary: keanggotaan periode ditentukan record_datetime (waktu kejadian penimbangan), inklusif di kedua ujung, TIDAK PERNAH created_at maupun waktu sinkronisasi mobile. Baris yang tersinkron terlambat tetap milik periode tempat ia terjadi
8. summary: baris dengan record_datetime NULL tidak dapat ditempatkan pada periode mana pun, jadi dikecualikan dari SELURUH angka; undated_trip_count menghitungnya untuk Production Line itu
9. summary: PISAH menurut weighbridge_type menjadi dua kelompok 'receive' dan 'dispatch'; NOL angka gabungan kedua arus dihasilkan

10. summary: net_weight_total = SUM atas baris yang net_weight NOT NULL; net_weight_trip_count = COUNT baris itu; net_weight_avg = total dibagi count, NULL bila count 0; trip_count = COUNT SELURUH baris arus itu termasuk yang net_weight NULL
11. summary: missing_net_weight_trip_count = COUNT baris arus itu yang net_weight NULL, per arus, tidak pernah digabung jadi satu angka
12. summary: hourly = 24 ember berdasarkan jam dari record_datetime; seluruh 24 jam hadir walau bernilai nol
13. summary: busiest_hour = jam dengan trip terbanyak (NULL bila arus itu nol trip bertanggal); empty_hour_count = berapa dari 24 jam yang nol trip
14. summary: by_origin dikelompokkan per estate_supplier (arus masuk), urut net_weight_total menurun, TIDAK PERNAH dipangkas dan tidak pernah ada ember 'lain-lain'

15. summary: by_destination dikelompokkan per destination (arus keluar), urut menurun; destination NULL membentuk SATU kelompok tersendiri dan TIDAK dibuang, sehingga jumlah trip seluruh kelompok tetap menjumlah ke trip_count arus keluar
16. summary: draft_trip_count = COUNT baris berstatus draft_ongoing atau draft_paused; baris draft TETAP ikut di seluruh angka lain — nol filter status diterapkan pada query metrik
17. summary: daily dikelompokkan per bagian tanggal record_datetime dengan keempat angka per tanggal; daily_total menjumlah seluruh baris daily, dan kedua arus tetap terpisah di daily_total
18. summary: completeness.days_in_period = jumlah hari kalender periode inklusif; days_with_trip = COUNT DISTINCT tanggal yang punya minimal satu trip

19. export: query sama dengan summary, satu baris per trip, konteks diulang; baris dengan net_weight NULL tetap muncul dengan sel kosong, bukan dibuang maupun ditulis 0; berkas TIDAK memuat kolom durasi

data_operations.description: SELECT trip pada production_line_id record DAN record_datetime di dalam rentang periode inklusif; dikelompokkan per weighbridge_type, per estate_supplier, per destination, per jam, dan per tanggal; COUNT terpisah untuk net_weight NULL, status draft, dan record_datetime NULL
SELECT periode yang mencakup station_type weighbridge atau tanpa jenis stasiun, untuk daftar dan untuk otorisasi satu periode
SELECT untuk memastikan production_line_id milik business_unit yang berlaku
SELECT daftar mill untuk pemilih Admin, dan untuk menetapkan mill akun bagi peran terikat

edge_case_handling.handling: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR pada field production_line_id; nol query weighbridge_records dijalankan — tidak ada fallback seluruh line

edge_case_handling.condition: period_id milik mill lain dan pemanggil terikat mill

edge_case_handling.handling: trip_count 0, total dan rata-rata NULL, by_origin/by_destination/daily kosong, days_with_trip 0 — nol angka dikarang
Kelompok arus itu TETAP hadir utuh dengan nilai NULL, 24 ember jam bernilai 0, busiest_hour NULL, empty_hour_count 24 — tidak pernah dihilangkan dari payload
total NULL, avg NULL, net_weight_trip_count 0, trip_count apa adanya, missing_net_weight_trip_count sama dengan trip_count

edge_case_handling.condition: Seluruh trip pada satu jam yang sama
edge_case_handling.handling: Satu ember berisi semuanya, 23 ember nol, empty_hour_count 23; sebaran tetap dihasilkan
Dikecualikan dari SELURUH angka; dihitung di undated_trip_count supaya selisihnya dapat dijelaskan pembaca
by_destination berisi satu kelompok null yang trip_count-nya sama dengan trip_count arus keluar
draft_trip_count sama dengan jumlah seluruh trip; seluruh angka tetap dihasilkan

edge_case_handling.condition: business_unit_id kiriman klien pada peran terikat mill
edge_case_handling.handling: Dibuang; mill akun yang dipakai; nol query menerima nilai kiriman itu

business_rules_applied: Layar hanya membaca; tidak ada aksi tulis
Supervisor dan Mill Management terkunci pada mill akunnya; Admin memilih
Operator tidak punya akses ke layar web ini
Daftar periode hanya yang mendaftarkan Weighbridge sebagai salah satu stasiunnya; konsep 'berlaku semua jenis stasiun' tidak ada lagi sejak migrasi 2026_09_26_000040
Status periode tidak membatasi pembacaan maupun ekspor
Rentang periode inklusif di kedua ujung
Production Line WAJIB dipilih; sebelum itu nol angka, bukan angka seluruh mill
Penyaringan line memakai kolom line pada record, bukan join ke stations
Keanggotaan periode dari record_datetime, bukan created_at maupun waktu sinkronisasi
Trip tanpa record_datetime dikecualikan dari semua angka dan jumlahnya ditampilkan
Arus masuk dan arus keluar TIDAK PERNAH dijumlahkan
Rata-rata berat hanya atas trip yang beratnya terisi, penyebutnya ditampilkan
Jumlah penimbangan belum selesai ditampilkan per arus
Trip arus keluar tanpa tujuan dikelompokkan tersendiri, tidak dibuang
Trip draft ikut terhitung dan jumlahnya ditampilkan
Tidak ada penandaan nilai di luar batas
Kelengkapan pencatatan adalah bagian dari laporan
TIDAK ADA angka lama kendaraan di pabrik di mana pun — datanya tidak ada

unit_test_cases.description: resolveBusinessUnit discards the client-sent business_unit_id for a mill-bound role and uses the account mill
unit_test_cases.given: auth user has role supervisor with business_unit_id = BU-A; request query carries business_unit_id = BU-B
unit_test_cases.expect: returns BU-A; the value BU-B is never passed to any query builder

unit_test_cases.description: resolveBusinessUnit uses the client-sent business_unit_id for Admin
unit_test_cases.given: auth user has role admin with business_unit_id = null; request query carries business_unit_id = BU-B
unit_test_cases.expect: returns BU-B

unit_test_cases.description: resolveBusinessUnit refuses a mill-bound account that has no mill attached
unit_test_cases.given: auth user has role mill_management and business_unit_id = null
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code VALIDATION_ERROR on field business_unit_id, message 'Akun Anda belum terhubung ke mill. Hubungi Admin.'; NOT a ForbiddenException — the account is unconfigured, not denied; and no list of all business units is ever read on that path (assert with a spy that allBusinessUnits() is never called)

unit_test_cases.description: businessUnitOptions returns the option list for Admin
unit_test_cases.given: auth user has role admin; businessUnitRepo.allActive() returns two units
unit_test_cases.expect: returns data array of two {id, name} entries

unit_test_cases.description: businessUnitOptions rejects a mill-bound role even though the route middleware admits it
unit_test_cases.given: auth user has role supervisor (middleware already allowed the request through)
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ForbiddenException with code FORBIDDEN; businessUnitRepo is never queried

unit_test_cases.description: resolveProductionLine accepts a line that belongs to the effective business unit
unit_test_cases.given: effective business_unit_id = BU-A; productionLineRepo.find(PL-1) returns a line whose business_unit_id = BU-A
unit_test_cases.expect: returns the PL-1 line model

unit_test_cases.description: resolveProductionLine refuses a line that belongs to another mill
unit_test_cases.given: effective business_unit_id = BU-A; productionLineRepo.find(PL-9) returns a line whose business_unit_id = BU-B
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ForbiddenException with code FORBIDDEN; no summary query is executed

unit_test_cases.description: resolveProductionLine returns 422 when production_line_id is absent instead of reporting all lines of the mill
unit_test_cases.given: request query has period_id but no production_line_id
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code VALIDATION_ERROR on field production_line_id; no weighbridge_records query runs — no all-lines fallback

unit_test_cases.description: listPeriods returns only periods that register weighbridge as one of their stations
unit_test_cases.given: BU-A holds P1 with a period_stations row for 'weighbridge', and P3 with a period_stations row for 'boiler-room' only
unit_test_cases.expect: returns P1 only; P3 is absent. There is no third case: periods.station_type was dropped by migration 2026_09_26_000040, so a period either registers weighbridge or it does not

unit_test_cases.description: listPeriods returns an empty list when no period registers weighbridge
unit_test_cases.given: BU-A holds only P3, whose single period_stations row is for 'boiler-room'
unit_test_cases.expect: returns an empty data array — not an error, and not every period of the mill

unit_test_cases.description: listPeriods reports the weighbridge station status per option and never filters on it
unit_test_cases.given: BU-A has P1 whose weighbridge period_stations row is 'open' and P2 whose weighbridge row is 'closed'
unit_test_cases.expect: both P1 and P2 are returned; each option's status is its own weighbridge period_stations.status, never Period::$status (which throws LogicException) and never the status of another station type in the same period

unit_test_cases.description: authorizePeriod returns 404 when the period id does not exist
unit_test_cases.given: caller role is supervisor and admitted; reportingPeriodRepo.find(P-missing) returns null
unit_test_cases.expect: throw NotFoundException with code NOT_FOUND

unit_test_cases.description: authorizePeriod returns 403 when the period belongs to another mill and the caller is mill-bound
unit_test_cases.given: caller business_unit_id = BU-A; reportingPeriodRepo.find(P5) returns a period whose business_unit_id = BU-B
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ForbiddenException with code FORBIDDEN

unit_test_cases.description: authorizePeriod runs the role guard before the period lookup so id existence does not leak
unit_test_cases.given: caller role is not admitted (e.g. operator) and period_id is a non-existent id
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ForbiddenException with code FORBIDDEN (not NOT_FOUND); reportingPeriodRepo.find() is never called

unit_test_cases.description: summary filters weighbridge_records on the production_line_id column of the record, never through a join to stations
unit_test_cases.given: record R1 carries production_line_id = PL-1 while its station has since been reassigned to PL-2; filter is PL-1
unit_test_cases.expect: R1 is included; the generated query references weighbridge_records.production_line_id and performs no join to the stations table for line filtering

unit_test_cases.description: summary treats the period range as inclusive at both ends on record_datetime
unit_test_cases.expect: only the first two records are counted; the day-before and day-after records are excluded from every figure

unit_test_cases.description: summary derives period membership from record_datetime, never created_at or the mobile sync time
unit_test_cases.given: record R1 has record_datetime inside the period but created_at well after the period ended; record R2 has record_datetime outside the period but created_at inside it
unit_test_cases.expect: R1 is counted, R2 is not; the query filters on record_datetime and never on created_at / synced_at

unit_test_cases.description: summary excludes rows whose record_datetime is NULL from every figure and counts them in undated_trip_count
unit_test_cases.given: line PL-1 has 4 records with record_datetime inside the period and 2 records with record_datetime NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: all trip_count / weight / hourly / by_origin / by_destination / daily figures reflect only the 4 dated rows; undated_trip_count = 2

unit_test_cases.description: summary splits records by weighbridge_type into the receive and dispatch groups
unit_test_cases.given: 5 records of weighbridge_type receive and 3 of weighbridge_type dispatch inside the period on PL-1
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.trip_count = 5 and dispatch.trip_count = 3, each with its own independent metric set

unit_test_cases.description: summary produces zero combined figure across the two flows
unit_test_cases.given: both flows contain records
unit_test_cases.expect: the returned payload contains no key totalling the two flows — no combined trip_count, no combined net_weight_total, no grand total anywhere

unit_test_cases.description: summary computes net_weight_total, net_weight_trip_count and net_weight_avg from rows whose net_weight is not NULL only
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has net_weight values 1000, 2000, 3000 and two rows with net_weight NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.net_weight_total = 6000, receive.net_weight_trip_count = 3, receive.net_weight_avg = 2000

unit_test_cases.description: summary returns net_weight_avg null when net_weight_trip_count is 0
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 4 records, every one with net_weight NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.net_weight_avg = null (no division by zero), receive.net_weight_total = null, receive.net_weight_trip_count = 0

unit_test_cases.description: summary counts trip_count over all rows of the flow including those with NULL net_weight
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 3 rows with net_weight and 2 rows with net_weight NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.trip_count = 5 while receive.net_weight_trip_count = 3

unit_test_cases.description: summary computes missing_net_weight_trip_count per flow as the count of rows with NULL net_weight
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 2 rows with NULL net_weight out of 5; dispatch flow has 1 out of 3
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.missing_net_weight_trip_count = 2 and dispatch.missing_net_weight_trip_count = 1, never merged into one number

unit_test_cases.description: summary returns hourly as 24 buckets keyed on the hour of record_datetime, every hour present even at zero
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has records at 07:10, 07:50 and 13:05
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.hourly has exactly 24 entries with hour 0..23; hour 7 has trip_count 2, hour 13 has trip_count 1, the remaining 21 hours have trip_count 0

unit_test_cases.description: summary buckets each record into the hour taken from its own record_datetime
unit_test_cases.given: a record with record_datetime 2026-09-04 23:59
unit_test_cases.expect: that record lands in the hour 23 bucket and in no other bucket

unit_test_cases.description: summary computes busiest_hour as the hour with the highest trip count and empty_hour_count as the number of zero hours
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 3 records at hour 7 and 1 at hour 13
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.busiest_hour = 7, receive.busiest_hour_trip_count = 3, receive.empty_hour_count = 22

unit_test_cases.description: summary returns busiest_hour null when the flow has no dated trip
unit_test_cases.given: dispatch flow has zero dated records in the period
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatch.busiest_hour = null, dispatch.busiest_hour_trip_count = 0, dispatch.empty_hour_count = 24

unit_test_cases.description: summary groups the receive flow by estate_supplier ordered by net_weight_total descending
unit_test_cases.given: receive records: Estate A total 9000, Supplier B total 15000, Estate C total 3000
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.by_origin order is Supplier B, Estate A, Estate C, each with its own trip_count and net_weight_total

unit_test_cases.description: summary never truncates by_origin and never collapses small contributors into an others bucket
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 1 dominant origin plus 11 origins with a single trip each
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.by_origin has 12 entries; no 'others'/'lain-lain' bucket exists and the entries' trip_count values sum exactly to receive.trip_count

unit_test_cases.description: summary groups the dispatch flow by destination ordered descending and keeps NULL destination as one group of its own
unit_test_cases.given: dispatch records: destination 'Refinery X' total 20000, destination 'Port Y' total 8000, and 3 records with destination NULL total 5000
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatch.by_destination order is Refinery X, Port Y, then the destination:null group with trip_count 3; the null group is not dropped

unit_test_cases.description: summary keeps the by_destination group trip counts summing exactly to the dispatch trip_count
unit_test_cases.given: dispatch flow has 10 dated records of which 4 have destination NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: the sum of every by_destination entry's trip_count equals dispatch.trip_count = 10

unit_test_cases.description: summary counts draft_trip_count over rows whose status is draft_ongoing or draft_paused
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has 2 records status draft_ongoing, 1 status draft_paused, 5 status completed
unit_test_cases.expect: draft_trip_count = 3

unit_test_cases.description: summary still counts draft rows in every other figure
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 4 records of which 3 are draft_ongoing, all with net_weight filled
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.trip_count = 4 and receive.net_weight_total includes all 4 records' weights; no status filter is applied to the metric queries

unit_test_cases.description: summary groups daily by the date part of record_datetime with all four numbers per date
unit_test_cases.given: records on 2026-09-01 (2 receive, 1 dispatch) and on 2026-09-02 (1 receive)
unit_test_cases.expect: daily has 2 entries, the 2026-09-01 entry carries receive_trip_count 2, receive_net_weight_total, dispatch_trip_count 1 and dispatch_net_weight_total

unit_test_cases.description: summary computes daily_total as the sum of every daily row
unit_test_cases.given: daily rows with receive_trip_count 2 and 1, dispatch_trip_count 1 and 0
unit_test_cases.expect: daily_total.receive_trip_count = 3, daily_total.dispatch_trip_count = 1, and the two weight totals equal the sum of the respective daily columns — the two flows remain separate in daily_total

unit_test_cases.description: summary computes completeness.days_in_period as the inclusive calendar day count of the period
unit_test_cases.given: period start_date 2026-09-01, end_date 2026-09-30
unit_test_cases.expect: completeness.days_in_period = 30 (both end days counted)

unit_test_cases.description: summary computes completeness.days_with_trip as COUNT DISTINCT dates having at least one trip
unit_test_cases.given: period of 30 days with dated records on only 3 distinct dates, two of which have several trips
unit_test_cases.expect: completeness.days_with_trip = 3

unit_test_cases.description: export emits one row per trip with the context columns repeated on every row
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has 7 dated records across both flows
unit_test_cases.expect: the streamed CSV has 7 data rows, and each row repeats period name, mill name, production line name and flow type

unit_test_cases.description: export keeps rows whose net_weight is NULL, writing an empty value instead of dropping the row
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has 5 records of which 2 have net_weight NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: the CSV has 5 data rows; the 2 rows show an empty net weight cell rather than being omitted or written as 0

unit_test_cases.description: export writes no duration column in the CSV header
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has records in both flows
unit_test_cases.expect: the header row contains no duration / lama kendaraan / turnaround column, and each row carries exactly one timestamp column sourced from record_datetime

unit_test_cases.description: summary returns null/zero figures and invents nothing when the period+line has zero trips
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_records has no row matching period range and PL-1
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.trip_count = 0, receive.net_weight_total = null, receive.net_weight_avg = null, receive.net_weight_trip_count = 0, dispatch identical, by_origin = [], by_destination = [], daily = [], completeness.days_with_trip = 0; no fabricated values

unit_test_cases.description: summary still returns a full group for a flow that has zero trips
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has 6 receive records and zero dispatch records
unit_test_cases.expect: the dispatch key is present with trip_count 0, net_weight_total null, net_weight_avg null, net_weight_trip_count 0, 24 hourly buckets at 0, busiest_hour null, empty_hour_count 24 and by_destination []; the group is never omitted from the payload

unit_test_cases.description: summary reports total null, avg null and net_weight_trip_count 0 while keeping trip_count when every net_weight is NULL
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has 6 receive records, all with net_weight NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: receive.trip_count = 6, receive.net_weight_total = null, receive.net_weight_avg = null, receive.net_weight_trip_count = 0, receive.missing_net_weight_trip_count = 6

unit_test_cases.description: summary places every trip in one bucket and reports empty_hour_count 23 when all trips happen in a single hour
unit_test_cases.given: receive flow has 9 records all with record_datetime inside hour 6
unit_test_cases.expect: hour 6 bucket trip_count = 9, the other 23 buckets trip_count = 0, busiest_hour = 6, busiest_hour_trip_count = 9, empty_hour_count = 23

unit_test_cases.description: summary returns by_destination as a single null group whose count equals the dispatch trip_count when every destination is NULL
unit_test_cases.given: dispatch flow has 5 dated records, every one with destination NULL
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatch.by_destination has exactly 1 entry with destination null and trip_count 5, equal to dispatch.trip_count

unit_test_cases.description: summary reports draft_trip_count equal to the total trip count and still produces every figure when all trips are draft
unit_test_cases.given: period+line has 8 dated records, all status draft_ongoing or draft_paused, with net_weight filled
unit_test_cases.expect: draft_trip_count = 8, receive.trip_count + dispatch.trip_count = 8, and all weight / hourly / by_origin / by_destination / daily / completeness figures are produced normally

unit_test_cases.description: summary ignores a client-sent business_unit_id for a mill-bound role and reports the account mill
unit_test_cases.given: auth user role supervisor with business_unit_id = BU-A; query carries business_unit_id = BU-B and a production_line_id belonging to BU-A
unit_test_cases.expect: the returned business_unit.id = BU-A and every figure is scoped to BU-A; no query ever receives BU-B

unit_test_cases.description: summary returns the full result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: mill-bound supervisor on BU-A, valid period_id covering weighbridge on BU-A, valid production_line_id of BU-A, records present in both flows with mixed net_weight, mixed destinations, mixed statuses and a spread of hours

implementation_notes: TIDAK ADA METRIK DURASI, DAN ITU DISENGAJA. Migrasi 2026_08_19_000010 menggabungkan arrival_datetime dan dispatch_datetime menjadi satu record_datetime lalu MEMBUANG keduanya di up(). Tiap trip kini menyimpan tepat satu penanda waktu — waktu datang untuk arus masuk, waktu keluar untuk arus keluar. Lama kendaraan di pabrik menuntut dua penanda waktu pada trip yang sama; datanya tidak ada, jadi metrik itu mustahil. Draft pertama spec ini sempat menetapkannya karena kedua kolom terbaca di blok down() migrasi tersebut — tempat mereka DIPULIHKAN saat rollback. Verifikasi yang benar: entity-catalog (yang sejak awal sudah betul), atau pindai seluruh migrasi dan jumlahkan tambah/buang hanya dari up(), lalu cocokkan dengan $fillable model.

KOREKSI v1→v2 (2026-10-01), DUA BUTIR, keduanya terungkap saat Phase 4 menaikkan spec_mismatch. (a) business_logic 4 dan unit_test_cases 8/9 memakai kosakata pra-2026-09-25: 'periode yang tidak menyebut jenis stasiun'. Kolom periods.station_type DIBUANG oleh migrasi 2026_09_26_000040; cakupan kini dinyatakan lewat baris period_stations per jenis stasiun, dan Period::$status MELEMPAR LogicException. Konsep 'periode untuk semua stasiun' tidak punya padanan di skema, sehingga unit_test_case 8 mustahil lolos sebagaimana tertulis. (b) Kasus akun terikat mill yang mill-nya kosong ditulis 403 FORBIDDEN di empat tempat — business_logic 1, unit_test_cases 2, error_codes /periods, dan kedua langkah api_test skenario 'akun belum terhubung ke mill'. Kelima laporan sejenis memakai 422 VALIDATION_ERROR dengan alasan tertulis di kodenya: 'Incomplete input, not refused access — 422, never 403'. Alasan itu benar — pengguna tidak ditolak aksesnya, data akunnya belum lengkap — jadi spec yang dikoreksi, bukan implementasinya. Catatan untuk pembaca berikutnya: agen Phase 4 melaporkan butir (b) sebagai 'spec bertentangan sendiri, 2 dari 3 lokasi'. Itu keliru; spec-nya seragam 403 di empat tempat, yakni salah secara konsisten, bukan ambigu. Ia memilih 422 dengan alasan yang salah dan kebetulan benar — persis mengapa pause spec_mismatch tidak boleh diputuskan agen sendiri.
Sebaran trip per jam adalah PENGGANTI metrik durasi, disetujui user. Dapat dihitung dari satu penanda waktu, dan mengikuti pola 'sebaran per jam' yang sudah ada di Laporan Cages & Tracks.

record_datetime nullable di DB SECARA SENGAJA: migrasi menyebut ->change() butuh doctrine/dbal yang tidak dipasang, jadi wajib-nya ditegakkan di lapisan aplikasi lewat aturan ['required','date'] di WeighbridgeRecordService. Baris NULL karena itu mungkin ada, dan akan dikecualikan diam-diam oleh filter periode — sebabnya undated_trip_count wajib ada.
GET /api/production-lines/options-for-report DIPAKAI ULANG apa adanya (dibuat untuk screen-135). Bukan endpoint baru, tidak ditambahkan ke api-index, dan tidak punya unit test di sini.

Rute web: /reports/weighbridge, nama reports.weighbridge, middleware ['auth','role:supervisor,mill_management,admin'], komponen Livewire App\Livewire\Dashboard\LaporanWeighbridge — mengikuti pola persis /reports/storage-tank. Satu laporan stasiun di repo ini terdiri dari ENAM berkas, bukan empat: service, controller, komponen Livewire, blade komponen, DAN blade layout pembungkus yang memegang <x-slot:styles>. resources/views/dashboard/partials/report-styles.blade.php bersifat bersama dan TIDAK boleh diubah.

Grup API memakai middleware ['auth:web,sanctum','role:supervisor,mill_management,admin'] — SENGAJA TANPA operator untuk sekarang. Laporan lain menyertakan operator karena pasangan mobile-nya sudah ada; screen-144 (mobile) belum dibangun. Operator dikecualikan di TIGA tempat — middleware API, guardAccess(), dan canAccess() — dan ketiganya harus dilebarkan bersamaan saat screen-144 dikerjakan: melebarkan rutenya saja akan menjatuhkan Operator ke cabang Admin, tempat business_unit_id kiriman klien JUSTRU dihormati.

WAJIB: tambahkan satu baris ke StationReportService::REPORT_ROUTES memetakan StationType::Weighbridge->value ke 'reports.weighbridge'. Tanpa baris itu laporan ini jadi, seluruh test-nya lolos, dan tile-nya tetap kelabu — layarnya tidak terjangkau dari UI. Komentar di konstanta itu memperingatkan hal yang sama. KONSEKUENSI: test tile-availability yang ada di StationReportServiceTest.php:425 mengasersi weighbridge report_available = false dan akan MERAH setelah baris ini ditambahkan. Test itu harus diperbarui bersamaan — kemerahannya adalah test lama yang kini salah, bukan kode baru yang rusak.

Urutan REPORT_ROUTES mengikuti station_types.sort_order. Diverifikasi dari migrasi 2026_09_22_000029: weighbridge 10, cages-track 30, sterilizer 40, clarification 70, boiler-room 90, storage-tank 140. Jadi barisnya masuk PALING DEPAN, bukan ditambahkan di akhir.
